jobs.title: Browser Automation Specialist – Parallel Workflow & Session Stability
jobs.client_problem: Build a stable, scalable multi-account browser workflow where a script launches multiple Chrome instances, manages persistent sessions, and drives automated pipelines.
jobs.proposal_draft:
Hi,

I saw your posting for the Browser Automation Specialist role to build a multi-account parallel Chrome workflow. Managing concurrent browser sessions without state collision or memory bloat is an engineering challenge I solve regularly.

My Architecture:
1. Isolated Profile Sandboxing: Separate user data directories (UserDataDir) with unique fingerprints and proxy binding per instance to avoid cross-session contamination.
2. Lifecycle & Memory Control: Concurrency pooling with automated process recycling to prevent orphaned headless Chrome processes from hogging system RAM.
3. Session Resiliency: Checkpointing state to disk after each key action, so transient failures resume without re-authenticating from scratch.

I can demonstrate live parallel browser architectures I run on our kickoff call.

How many concurrent Chrome instances are you planning to run per worker machine?

Best regards,
Roee
